convention: V(u)-V(0)=k2*u²/2+k4*u⁴/4; k2 from the small-step force Hessian.
isotope_rule: Local frozen-host vibration uses the proton/deuteron mass. Force constants already contain self-consistent electronic screening.

100.inversion_assumption: Ideal centrosymmetric rocksalt O site; V(-u)=V(u).

111.inversion_assumption: Ideal centrosymmetric rocksalt O site; V(-u)=V(u).

coupling.q0_definition: k2_onsite-sum(J_neighbours), J=-Phi_xx. H/D subspace only, metals fixed; not the all-ion acoustic sum.

electronic.screening_definition: Independent-electron finite-T compressibility, dn/dmu from0.1eV Fermi occupations; not a measured dielectric length.
